title: File-backed Physics Question
description: Minimal file-first question model. The production source of truth is question body, answer body, assets, and optional loose metadata. It does not hard-code question types, options, solution steps, or answer subtypes.

question_id.description: Directory name under questions/. Must not start with a dot.

question_body.description: Question body as Markdown, LaTeX, or plain text.

answer_body.description: Answer body as Markdown, LaTeX, or plain text. Detailed solution text belongs here if needed.

metadata.description: Optional loose metadata such as title, source, knowledge_points, tags, or notes. It is not the core question structure.
